title: Soldiers in Benin say they have seized power from President Talon
summary: A message from the French embassy in Benin said gunfire had been reported near the residence of the president.

title: Is the religious right on the rise in UK politics?
summary: Powerful Christian figures are emerging in Britain but there are important differences from the US, where evangelism has fuelled Trump At recent Reform UK press conferences, two very distinctive heads can often be spotted in the front row: the near-white locks of Danny Kruger, the party’s head of policy, and the swept-back blond mane of James Orr, now a senior adviser to Nigel Farage. As well as guiding the policy programme for what could be the UK’s next government, the pair have something else in common. Both are highly devout Christians who came to religion in adulthood, and have trenchant views on social issues such as abortion and the family. Continue reading...

title: Benin coup attempt live: Soldiers on state TV claim to have toppled Talon
summary: Group of soldiers announce the removal of President Patrice Talon and all state institutions.
